title: THE RAID BACKPACK IS A COMPACT PANEL WITH READABLE TEXT
why: The critic scored the raid backpack 2 of 5: a wide mostly empty slab, tiny low contrast text, three lonely slots. Now an 8 wide grid of 72 px tiles so the panel hugs its items, all text at the 16 px label size in the guide greys, a screen size white title, a lime selection ring, no lime tab, and hints that wrap. Layout and look only.
now: The raid backpack is a compact panel with larger tiles and readable text.
